{{Top|leg}}
The '''motion tracker''' was an upgrade that increased a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] perception of combat and allowed for the better tracking of moving targets.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
